steps.content: After an intense battle, the cyborg bodyguard finally ceases movement.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...The mental intervention worked.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: S9 is fully immobilized and can no longer engage in combat for now. We can proceed with the retrieval process.
You wait cautiously as the team conducts their initial examination of S9. Her neural activity and physical functions have both ceased, a state essentially equivalent to physiological shock.
Moving closer, you ascertain that she is not under the influence of any Mania creature nor subjected to mental manipulation. Then what could it be that controlls her...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief!
In a split second, S9 springs up and, with movements impossible for any human, contorts her body to evade attacks before instantly taking down the nearest soldier.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: How's that possible? She's moving even faster than before!

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: She's being controlled. Someone is forcing her to attack the Bureau, but she's still fighting against it!
Was her inflexible movement before because her own will was resisting control? Now that S9 is unconscious, who is fully controlling her?

As thoughts flood your mind, S9 dashes toward you in an instant, her metal arm striking your abdomen. Then, she carries you away at an astonishing speed, the abrupt acceleration almost causing you to black out. In that fleeting moment, one matter dawns upon you—
The enemy's target now, is YOU.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!!
[Black Screen Transition] 2s
[Scene Change] (War's entrance small CG, background only with no character portrait)
It's when your body is slammed violently against the ground that you regain consciousness.

Though your vision and consciousness are blurry, you can still make out your immediate surroundings. S9, who was coerced into "kidnapping" you, lies collapsed nearby. Her body convulses, the strain of the sustained high-speed sprint having pushed her physical form beyond its limits.
You extend your arm towards her, yet she lies beyond your reach. Then, almost instinctively, you release the only thing you have that can touch her...
[Release the shackles]
[Shackle effect fades, followed by a blue flash]
Just as the shackles begin to glow red, bullets fire from another direction, striking the ground near you. Blue electrical arcs crackle as an unknown force swiftly pins you down.
Not far away, a figure emerges above your sight.
[Small CG - War single portrait]

steps.speaker: Icy Mechanical Voice
steps.content: Just as I thought... an unexpected gift.
